venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.notes_summary: Really good Sunday at CC Nashville. Strong open, mid-shift lull for cleaning/prep, then steady 9pm-close stream of regulars, business parties, birthday groups, out-of-towners and tattoo artists. Mostly locals and regulars. Industry birthday party of 12 on a "Campari Safari" in bucket hats and safari shirts; smooth kitchen; no incidents.

highlights.text: Beat target by $180 (+8.9%) with 65 guests and strong regular turnout
Industry birthday crew of 12 doing "Campari Safari" — fun theme night, near-empty bottle by time they arrived

venues.name: Municipal Grand
venues.notes_summary: Mellow Sunday AM (80 guests) with few reservations and few hotel guests; bar cut back early. Bachelorette parties drove AM volume. Evening (130 covers) started steady, hit a walk-in-driven wave 6:30pm filling dining room from 50% to 100% in 20 min, stayed busy until ~8:30, then smooth sailing. Sun Club slow (only 258 in sales). Hot Eye slow start, picked up 9pm with scheduled bar crawl; full house of service industry till last call. Two 86s in kitchen (Affogato, Caviar); brief hashbrown 86.

highlights.text: Beat target by $318 (+3.7%) — 210 total guests across outlets
Bar crawl at 9pm filled Hot Eye with industry friends; strong nightcap scene
Sun Club light ($258) — no sales after 4pm

venues.name: D&C LA
venues.notes_summary: Steady Sunday at D&C LA. Opened with 40 covers on the books, got a decent walk-in wave right after open. Filled room by 8pm, short waitlist accommodated quickly. Several larger walk-in parties; familiar faces throughout. Final hour sleepy, smooth end to service. Howlin Rays crew stopped in with chicken. All sales via Marquee (Standing Room $0).

highlights.text: Beat target by $805 (+25.6%) — 119 guests, strong Sunday
Howlin Rays crew visited, brought chicken for team
Standing Room closed/zero sales — all volume through Marquee

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.notes_summary: Semi-busy Sunday — less than expected given weekend volume. Surprising number of no-shows (no CC on file). DC/AM $1,107; D&C PM $8,212; Garden/6A $1,535. Met two new Community Members (Alex & Todd). Long guest interactions and lots of smiles after a heavy weekend.

highlights.text: Crushed target by $3,618 (+63.5%) — 234 guests, avg check $39.83
Unusual no-show volume — none had CC on file, review Tock/confirmation flow
Met two new Community Members (Alex & Todd) — excellent hospitality touchpoint

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.weather: Rainy day breaking into mild spring evening
venues.notes_summary: Busy 7-11pm with many reservations, lots of twos, and large parties (144 covers, 4 large parties, 7 solos, 1 investor cocktail). Steady flow throughout — what looked like a jammer Sunday was a steady flow. Room filled during 6pm hour; strong 8pm turn. Cold temperatures in latter half; last hour slower. Retail sold $140. Top sellers: material control, first time listener, year of the trees. One unconfirmed Tock reservation ("Hayden") accommodated anyway.
maintenance_flags: Tock glitch creating phantom reservations — needs fix imminently

highlights.text: Beat target by $1,996 (+57.7%) — 144 guests, avg check $37.90
Tock reservation glitch — phantom reservations showing confirmations we don't see. Needs fix ASAP
Beverage-heavy mix: top seven drinks all shaken — $4,538 bev vs $673 food
